titleInfo.title: Hughes, the private diaries, memos and letters
titleInfo.subTitle: the definitive biography of the first American billionaire

physicalDescription.extent: xii, 444 p., [12] p. of plates : ill. ; 25 cm.

abstract.#text: In presenting this biography of Howard Hughes, the author tells the story of "the man behind the myth. He was a playboy whose sexual exploits with Hollywood stars and starlets were legendary. He was a man without compassion; an entrepreneur without ethics; an explorer without maps; and ultimately, an eccentric trapped by his own insanity, sealed off from reality, who died a lonely and, until now, mysterious death."--Jacket.

Ba-Ba-Re-Bop -- The King of Las Vegas -- The Richest Man in America -- The Great Divide -- Isolation -- Being of Sound Mind and Body -- Epilogue: And the Winner Is.

physicalLocation.#text: Baker Library, Harvard Business School, Harvard University
